verdict.rationale: Kimi's help center lists sections on installing, creating and publishing Kimi plugins and skills (kimi-docs-13), and skills appear as a general feature (kimi-docs-14). That suggests users can author and share reusable extensions, but these are only one-line index entries and not clearly 'custom assistants'. missing for 10: evidence of custom assistants/personas with their own system instructions, attaching knowledge files or knowledge bases, a documented sharing or discovery mechanism for such assistants, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
